internet.permissionPolicy: Endpoints are proposals, not verified permissions. Robots and explicit applicable reuse terms must pass before article fetch/extraction. UNESCO is an independent publisher candidate; skip article collection if license is absent, restricted, or does not cover that page. EN/VI Wikivoyage share one publisher family. No raw complete articles retained. Keep excerpts, locators, hashes, attribution and applicable ShareAlike obligations. Count every robots/license/redirect/failure against 50; stop a domain on access/connection failure; no alternate transport or retry bypass. Existing SSRF/DNS/private-IP/redirect/body/timeout guards remain enforced.

scopedStagingFixtures.approval: Separate exact source/actor/fixture IDs and bounded acceptance packet will be prepared after audit/source lock; no prior approvals reused.

realCandidateRetention.policy: Owner must separately approve exact newly imported IDs, expiry and retention; none implied by Internet or fixture approval.

factLevelApproval.policy: Fresh binding + real authenticated SUPER_ADMIN reviews each presented fact; no synthetic signature or automatic approval.
